# QR encoder

`qrcode.php`: Kazuhiko Arase, MIT license, https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/blob/master/php/qrcode.php . Retrieved 2026-11-03. Original copyright/license notice retained. Used only as a local QR matrix encoder; no network calls, no GD extension required. SVG output is produced by `includes/payments.php` from a validated VietQR payload.
